lines: Let's hear the reason for your intrusion.
The tables had turned with Tokiko's arrival. There were only two drones remaining and Major was cornered.
Saika... who the hell is that woman!?
A cyborg. She's Danjo-sama's... your honorable father's former ally... and a member of the UFS's secret service agency "G."
There ya have it. Nice to meetcha, rookie♪
The woman looked at me like someone would look at a kitten. She was completely looking down on me.
And why is that cyborg targeting Saika?
To prevent information from being leaked. And even then, I would've let her live if she'd just be my friend.
You used force for that? I can't say I admire the way you make friends.
Also, that woman's "legs" used to belong to us.
So I was just getting them back, what's wrong with that?!!!
On Major's signal, the drones came after Tokiko and Saika.
The two beat them back easily, but in that brief momentー
Major smashed right through the window and the shutters, and disappeared in an instant.
Ah, wait! We're not gonna let you get away!!!
Young Lord! Don't act rashly. As you could tell, Major is quite powerful. She might still be up to something.
I am the head of the Fuma clan. If a member of my clan is targeted, I have to retaliate twofold... isn't that so?
And even taking away the fact that I'm the head of the clan, I would hate staying silent and watching someone get away after they targeted your life.
Saika calmly got down on one knee and replied. Next to her, Tokiko quietly closed her eyes.
I'm tracking Major with my Clairvoyant Eye. She's passing along the mountain road... It looks like she's trying to get away from Gosha.
Once Tokiko's Clairvoyant Eye caught hold of you, it was difficult to escape.
Had Major sensed the presence of the pursuers tracking her relentlessly?
She was waiting for us partway down the mountain road, on a flat expanse that was overrun with weeds.
Hey, I've been waiting for ya.
Looks like you know when to give up.
Yeah, seems like I can't escape. I surrender, rookie.
With a smile on the corners of her lips, Major issued her surrender.
Ohh, you're a distrustful secretary, hm.
Hey, with that metal bat of yours, I bet you couldn't go all out inside the house? Especially against Saika's legs and Tokiko's Kunai.
And you told the drones to take my knees out and hold me hostage.
Hmm, your memory is somethin' else.
Without failing to notice the slight change in Major's complexion, I continued nonchalantly.
I think I know the specifications of UFS drones to some extent, and those were not drones that can understand such complex voice commands.
So the soldiers controlling those drones were hiding nearby, operating them according to your instructions... or something to that effect.
And this location. It's the perfect terrain to prepare an ambush with your troops.
One after the other, screams could be heard from the shadows of the overgrowth.
Tokiko had surprise attacked the soldiers that had been lying in wait.
You too, Master. Good job spotting those soldiers.
She was trapped like a rat. All that was left was to apprehend herー
